title: Sky Kingdom - The Floating Continents
lore: When the old world sank beneath the Cloud Sea, its mountain-tops broke free and rose. The Sky Kingdom now drifts on those islands, linked by rope bridges and sky-ships. At its centre the Storm Temple holds a captive thunderstorm, and a sunken bell tower can still be glimpsed through gaps in the clouds far below.
notes: Islands float via drivers; bridges sag procedurally
Captive storm with randomised lightning flashes
Secret: sunken bell tower visible below the cloud sea
